start/end = geodesic bearing centre to vertex i / i+1 (6 decimals); signed sweep in goaixm's convention: CWA end = start + clockwise sweep, CCA end = start - counter-clockwise sweep, sweep in (0, 360); a vertex within that tolerance of the arc end computed from centre, radius and angle (same bearing) is written as that end, so the ring is continuous and does not cross itself (lossy, the distance in the note; vertices farther away are kept); zero sweep: arc omitted (arc_degenerate); end distance off the radius by more than max(20 m, 0.5 %) gives arc_radius_mismatch (radius kept); centre or radius unusable: great circle (arc_invalid)
